name: Happy Princess ~Another Fairytale~
original_name: はっぴぃプリンセス～Another Fairytale～
source: In this fandisc for Happy Princess you can play new stories with the main games heroines as well as a unique story with a new heroine, Nikita.
translation: 在《Happy Princess》的这部Fan Disc中，你不仅可以体验与本篇女主角们有关的新故事，还能游玩以新女主角妮基塔为中心的独立篇章。
